title: API Test Configuration JSON
description: Schema for validation of API Test Framework configuration files

tests.description: Collection of configurations for API tests

items.description: Configurations for a specifig API test

name.description: Name of the API test (as defined in C++ source file)

data.description: Collection of different parameters for a given API test

items.description: Set of parameters for one run of API test

parameters.description: Parameters definition for test run. Parameter types are defined by test source code

result.description: Expected test result for given parameters set. Can be one of the following: success, value, vector, object, file, text, json, json_file, throws

baseline.description: Baseline file. For file result tests, it's a file to compare with one generated by API. For vector result tests, it's a binary file with a vector data that's expected

file.description: For file and json_file results. Path to expected file generated by API call. Path should be relative to ./segysdk/testdata/

textfile.description: For text results only. Path to a file, that contains text to compare with one generated by API. Path should be relative to ./segysdk/testdata/

jsonfile.description: For json and json_file results. Path to JSON file to compare generated JSON with. Path should be relative to ./segysdk/testdata/

exception.description: For throws result only. Message text of an exception generated by API call
